name: Mysterious Language
description: You are given a mysterious language (codenamed "Secret") available in "Custom Invocation" tab. Figure out what this language is and write a program which prints its name. Note that the program must be written in this language.
input_specification: This program has only one test (your program doesn't have to read anything).
output_specification: Output the name of the mysterious language. Note that the name is case-sensitive and might contain digits and special characters.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
